derivation_note: DERIVED: the recursive retry/switch/labeled-break logic itself is pure (and the sibling CONTROL FLOW occurrence in job_19 IS executed standalone to validate that style of logic), but this specific block's errorCount accumulates in globalMap across rows and is read by downstream RUN_IF connections, so the block as a whole is Talend-coupled. Reasoned through assuming errorCount starts at 0 for a fresh run.
